title: Axiom Repro: Execute Analyzer Script
abstract: Executing the staged `run_analyzer.py` script within the isolated experiment directory. This will process the copied data using the copied framework and generate the first reproduction report.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import os

script_path = "storage/telos/experiments/exp_001_reproduce_axiom_i_s_archive_2_results_/run_analyzer.py"

if not os.path.exists(script_path):
  print(f"ERROR: Script not found at {script_path}")
  raise FileNotFoundError("Reproduction script is missing.")

print(f"Executing script: {script_path}")
result = subprocess.run(['python', script_path], capture_output=True, text=True)

print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode != 0:
  raise Exception("Reproduction script failed.")

print("Reproduction script executed successfully.")
